statements.status_notes: GO-2026-6905 is a panic on a negative member size in Reader.Read of github.com/blakesmith/ar. The module publishes no tagged release and the advisory lists no fixed version. Kubescape v4 and v3 build from source and reach the module only indirectly, through github.com/anchore/syft (Debian package cataloger) and github.com/anchore/grype; no kubescape package imports it directly. Whether a crafted archive can reach the panic through kubescape's image scan path has not been established, so the status stays under_investigation until an upstream fix exists or the path is ruled out.
